reason: Adds browser-based Chinese, English, and mixed-language voice dictation to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer through a microphone button.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框添加基于浏览器 Web Speech API 的中英文及混合语音输入功能。
summaries.en: Adds Chinese, English, and mixed-language voice dictation to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer using the browser Web Speech API.

capabilities: Captures microphone speech through the browser Web Speech API
Uses the browser's speech recognition service to transcribe Chinese and English speech
Inserts recognized speech into the web composer draft
